OLD redneck potato soup recipe. My grandparents lived thru the depression (usa).

potatoes, peeled and cubed

onions, about 1/2 or 2/3 as much as potato quantity

water

bacon grease (at least a tablespoon for a big pot)

salt, pepper, garlic, crushed red pepper.

original recipe thickened by flour/water mixture (mix in bowl to get lumps out BEFORE adding to soup pot)

newer version (me/my mom's friend) thickened with boxed mash potatoes, or throw in a couple extra WHOLE potatoes, take 'em out and mash'em, then put back in soup.

also newer version we add GOYA "ham flavored seasoning" packets. To make old style, throw a ham hock in there instead of bacon grease.

simmer till potatoes and onions are tender to your liking.
